metadata.description:
This POAP (Proof of Attendance Protocol) commemorates your unconditional support to the FIFA World Cup winning team, Argentina.

Congratulations to the winners, and to all the fans who supported them every step of the way!

Argentina's National Football Team: 

1  GK  Franco Armani  
12  GK  Gerónimo Rulli  
23  GK  Emiliano Martínez

2  DF  Juan Foyth  
3  DF  Nicolás Tagliafico  
4  DF  Gonzalo Montiel  
6  DF  Germán Pezzella  
8  DF  Marcos Acuña  
13  DF  Cristian Romero  
19  DF  Nicolás Otamendi  
25  DF  Lisandro Martínez  
26  DF  Nahuel Molina  

5  MF  Leandro Paredes  
7  MF  Rodrigo De Paul  
14  MF  Exequiel Palacios  
16  MF  Thiago Almada  
17  MF  Alejandro Gómez  
18  MF  Guido Rodríguez  
20  MF  Alexis Mac Allister
24  MF  Enzo Fernández  

9  FW  Julián Álvarez  
10  FW  Lionel Messi (captain)  
11  FW  Ángel Di María  
15  FW                Ángel Correa  
21  FW  Paulo Dybala  
22  FW  Lautaro Martínez

HC Lionel Scaloni & Coaching staff
